storage: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place for up to 12 months; keep cooked rajma in the fridge for 3 to 4 days or freeze for a few weeks.
looksLike: Kidney-shaped dried beans about 1.5 cm long; red rajma is glossy dark red-maroon, while Chitra rajma is smaller and pink with red speckles.
howToPick: Whole, evenly coloured, glossy beans of similar size with no holes, dust or broken pieces. Old beans look dull and wrinkled and take much longer to soften.
shelfLife: About a year in a dry airtight jar, but older beans cook slowly (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 50 g dry per serving (about 125 g once boiled)
